about: One strain under several names, across growers. Each key is the name the strain index and the strain's page are shown under; its list holds the other names shops print for the same plant. A listing keeps its own name: on the strain's page each grower is shown with the name it sells it under (src/lib/strain-review.ts strainFamilies, applied in src/lib/shelf.ts). Spellings that looseKey already folds — case, spaces, #, a doubled letter, a z or s at the end — need no entry. Numbered cuts are their own strains (Gelato 33 is not Gelato 41, Gorilla Glue #6 is not #4) and stay apart. The owner's rule, 18 October 2026: no duplicates in the index, each brand's own name inside.
